notes.text: Denied ST-DOC. Faxed records request to Riverside Derm for TCS + TCI trial notes w/ dates.

notes.text: Chart notes received from Riverside, attached as DOC-1042-02. Haven't resubmitted yet, out tomorrow.

notes.text: Resubmitted w/ full TCS + TCI trial notes, dates and outcomes. Looks complete to me.

notes.text: Denied again, same code. Reviewer note is vague. 2nd denial.

notes.text: Called Hudson Valley re NF-PREF pend. MA (Jess) said she thinks patient 'had a reaction to the biosimilar' at some point last year, before Humira. She'll look for records and fax.

notes.author: Lee W. (Access Ops)
notes.text: Chart notes in (DOC-1077-02). I don't see any biosimilar anywhere in the med history, goes straight MTX -> Humira. Called office back to ask about the reaction Jess mentioned, left VM.

notes.author: Priya M. (Access Ops)
notes.text: Pended CLIN-INFO, need IGA or BSA. Step therapy docs look complete.

notes.author: Jordan T. (Access Ops)
notes.text: Denied ST-NOTMET. Chart says pt avoiding MTX bc of liver stuff. Can we file this as a contraindication exception? Policy just says 'documented contraindication or intolerance'. Not sure mildly elevated ALT + preference counts.

notes.author: Lee W. (Access Ops)
notes.text: ELIG denial. Patient called back: started a new job, says new insurance is Northwind as of 10/01. Has the card, will send photo.

notes.author: Jordan T. (Access Ops)

notes.text: PA form says the biosimilar was tried, chart says biologic-naive before Humira. Which is it?
